items.title: 33.5 Pani ki aaloodgi ka mahol par asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 33.5 (PDF 255-256); the biomagnification drawing is our own. Quick Check answers were written for the lesson and need review.

blocks.text: Pollutants pani ki physical aur chemical properties badal dete hain, jis se paudon aur janwaron ka zinda rehna mushkil ho jata hai. Mahol par aam asraat yeh hain: biodiversity (jandaron ki qismon) ka nuqsan, maskanon (habitats) ki tabahi, food chains ka bigarna aur pani ki quality ka girna.

Tel, heavy metals aur pesticides jaisi pollution, aur daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein jane wale nuqsan-deh chemicals, plastic aur kachra, ecosystems aur aabi zindagi ko sakht nuqsan dete hain. Polluted pani mein oxygen kam ho jati hai (hypoxia), aur aabi jandaron ka zinda rehna mushkil ho jata hai. Coral reefs kharab hote hain aur food chains bigar jati hain. Zehreele chemicals, sewage aur industry ka waste aabi jandaron ko maar ya nuqsan pohancha sakte hain, is liye pani mein zindagi ki qismein kam ho jati hain. Polluted pani bachay paida karne ke chakkar (breeding cycles), khurak ke zaraye aur hijrat (migration) ke raaste bigar deta hai; is se jandaron ki tadaad ghatti hai aur nazuk (sensitive) qismein bilkul khatam (extinct) bhi ho sakti hain. Pani par depend karne wale parinde aur janwar bhi mutasir hote hain.

Fertilizers aur sewage se aane wali faltu nitrogen aur phosphorus algae ko tezi se barhati hai. Algae dhoop rok leti hai aur pani mein oxygen kam kar deti hai. Eutrophication ecosystems bigarti, machhliyan aur doosre aabi jandaar maarti aur pani ki quality kharab karti hai.

Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification pani ki pollution ke sangeen asraat hain: mercury, lead aur pesticides jaise zehreele maddey waqt ke saath jandaron ke jism mein jama hote jate hain (bioaccumulation). Food chain mein har qadam oopar jate hue in zehron ki concentration barhti jati hai (biomagnification). Is liye sab se oopar ke shikari (top predators), insan samet, aksar sab se zyada miqdar (dose) lete hain.

blocks.alt: Barhti oonchai ke paanch dabbe teeron se jure: pani, plankton, chhoti machhli, bari machhli, aur insan samet oopar ke shikari. Mercury, lead ya pesticide jaise zehr ke surkh nuqte baen se daen har dabbe mein barhte jate hain.
blocks.caption: Bioaccumulation aur biomagnification (topic 33.5 ka asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har janwar apne neeche ke bohat se jandaar khata aur zehr ko nikalne ke bajaye jama karta hai, is liye food chain ke har qadam par concentration barhta hai.

blocks.text: 4. Mitti ki kharabi aur paudon ko nuqsan

Pani ki pollution mitti ko kharab (soil degradation) karti aur paudon ko nuqsan deti hai. Heavy metals, industry ka waste aur faltu nutrients mitti mein jazb ho kar us ki banawat (structure) aur zarkhezi (fertility) badal dete hain. Jama hue chemicals mitti ke qudrati microbes ka kaam bigarte hain, jo paudon ki sehat ke liye zaroori hai. Polluted pani lagne se paude chhote reh jate hain (stunted growth), patte be-rang ho jate hain, aur paude mar bhi sakte hain.
5. Galte organic maddah se Methane ka nikalna

Jab sewage, kheton ka behta pani ya industry ka waste pani mein jata hai to algae aur doosre jandaar tezi se barhte hain. Jab yeh mar kar kam oxygen wale (anaerobic) halaat mein galte hain to methane nikalti hai, jo ek taqatwar greenhouse gas hai. Yeh faltu methane climate change (mausami tabdeeli) aur global warming ko barhati hai.

blocks.prompt: a) (i) Methylmercury ([CH₃Hg]⁺) “charbi mein bohat ghulti” hai. Is ki banawat ka inorganic Hg²⁺ ion se muqabla karein, aur batayein ke methyl group (-CH₃) cell ki lipid bilayer mein is ki solubility kyun badal deta hai.
blocks.explanation: Hg²⁺ chhota ion hai jis par 2+ charge hai; pani ke molecules ise mazbooti se gher lete hain, is liye yeh pani mein rehta hai aur non-polar lipid bilayer paar nahi kar pata. [CH₃Hg]⁺ mein mercury se non-polar methyl group jura hai aur charge sirf 1+ hai, is liye yeh kam polar hai, lipid bilayer mein ghul jata hai aur cell ki jhilliyan aur blood-brain barrier paar kar leta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) (ii) Agar [CH₃Hg]⁺ pani mein bohat ghulta aur charbi mein kam ghulta to biomagnification par kya asar hota?
blocks.explanation: Biomagnification bohat kam hoti: pani mein ghulne wala maddah peshab (urine) waghera se jaldi jism se nikal jata hai aur charbi ke tissues mein jama nahi hota, is liye food chain ke har qadam par nahi barhta.

blocks.prompt: b) Pani ki pollution global warming mein kaise hissa dalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Sewage aur nutrients wala pani algae aur doosre jandaron ko barhata hai; jab yeh kam oxygen (anaerobic) halaat mein mar kar galte hain to methane nikalti hai, jo taqatwar greenhouse gas hai.

items: Asraat: ecosystems aur biodiversity ki tabahi, eutrophication, bioaccumulation aur biomagnification, mitti aur paudon ka nuqsan, methane.
Top predators, insan samet, sab se zyada zehr lete hain.
